verdict.rationale: Unit's docs claim real-time balances and transaction data on a native ledger, real-time card authorization, and settlement-level transaction visibility. A Webhook Events docs page exists, but the pack shows only its title, so its event coverage is unknown. missing for 10: evidence that balance reads expose holds/pending amounts, documentation that webhooks fire for every transaction state change, details of webhook event types or delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
